Been talking with other guilds and these are some ideas that have been passed around:

Quest rewards - rewards given to users from the mods/admins for completing a task. This is necessary to generate an easy starting capital for those new users. A specific mod could be hired to deal with confirming the task is completed (such as "build your first house", etc) and then transfers the money into there account.

Town and community support - Money could be given (again by admins/mods) to those needing funding on a starting project or town development. This would again generate the economy for those individuals to purchase items in the shops for their constructions and start the flow of money. This also allows them the freedom of concentrating there efforts on the actual construction of new buildings instead of having to continuously stop for more supply harvesting.

ATM's (Automatic Trade Machines) - Basically this works by having designated "trade" chests. User 1 has a stack of diamonds to sell to User 2, User 1 puts diamonds in the chest and places the cost at $1000, User 2 clicks the chest and purchases the items for that amount which is deposited into User 1's account. All towns can have these locations and if User 2 doesn't have the money required then User 1 isn't swindled on a "you first" kinda deal.

Shop & Guild Trade Agreements - Set bulk sold from Guilds to the Shop owner. ATM's would be needed in shops backrooms for unloading purposes (Guild member puts 5 bulk item types in chest, sets price then lets owner by the bulk). Supplying the shop owners with bulk supplies that they don't have to harvest allows them more time to become "specialized shops" (potions/eq/etc). The specialized items will attract customers, while they are there they may pick up a stack of cooked chicken or next project they start they remember that shop in Thornwood that had a doublechest of black wool they will need.
